gaps: The exact PATCH /trade/{{rfpTradeId}} request with only remarks cannot be represented: extend_round may include its default increase_auction_time and the available tradeId token does not explicitly provide rfpTradeId.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with a technical (RFP) round and a pricing (RFQ) round attached, not published.
steps: The buyer moves the technical round's bid end time with the remarks set to “QA_Platform_extend_…”.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
